behavior: Before creating the guest or Chrome renderer, if STATE.bundle.json exists, require complete status, matching guest/VRAM/base image paths, and RAM/OS/game companion sizes and streamed SHA-256. Identical copies at different paths are accepted. Legacy snapshots without manifests retain their investigation restore path.

tests.unit: Matching and relocated companions accepted; same-size wrong pagefile bytes, missing overlays, wrong guest/VRAM/game image, changed RAM size and incomplete manifest rejected. Added to devices-test.
tests.nativeFiles: Real XP 03 bundle: 1424508652-byte RAM, 105930708-byte OS overlay, 28414-byte game overlay verified. Earlier GT4 source OS overlay was byte-identical and correctly accepted; another native XP OS overlay was rejected.

limitation: Legacy snapshots without manifests cannot have disk pairing retroactively proven. This does not attribute earlier native failures to disk mismatch.
